decisions.reason: The adjustable quarter-pallet shelf display is a flexible core format close to the established offer and costs little to keep in the range, even though it has been less visible on the website since 2020.
The pegboard-back display still serves hanging-product promotions using existing production, but it has not been observed recently, which raises the risk it is phased out.
The standard quarter-pallet display is a staple retail format with steady demand and fits the firm's cardboard core.
The wooden pallet departs from the cardboard core and has not been observed recently, but it complements display shipments, so it is kept for now while its risk of withdrawal stays elevated.
